rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a fee paid to an agent or broker on a transaction.

example.english: How much commission do I have to pay the agent when buying a flat?
example.traditional: 買樓嗰陣要畀幾多佣金畀經紀呀？
example.jyutping: maai5 lau4 go2 zan6 jiu3 bei2 gei2 do1 jung2 gam1 bei2 ging1 gei2 aa3

rows.note: Use this for an official committee or body established to carry out a particular function.

example.english: This commission is specifically responsible for building safety issues.
example.traditional: 呢個委員會專門處理樓宇安全問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wai2 jyun4 wui2 zyun1 mun4 cyu2 lei5 lau4 jyu5 on1 cyun4 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for a task or piece of work entrusted to someone to carry out for another person or organization.

example.english: The government decided to commission a consulting firm to conduct a feasibility study.
example.traditional: 政府決定委託顧問公司進行可行性研究。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 wai2 tok3 gu3 man6 gung1 si1 zeon3 hang4 ho2 hang4 sing3 jin4 gau3

rows.note: Use this for a concealed commission or kickback connected with promoting a particular product.

example.english: People say this shop secretly pays a commission to people who refer customers.
example.traditional: 有人話呢間舖頭暗中俾回佣畀介紹客人嘅人。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 waa6 ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 am3 zung1 bei2 wui4 jung2 bei2 gaai3 siu6 haak3 jan4 ge3 jan4
